description.value: Maruhachi Ra-men is a ramen restaurant chain with a West End Vancouver branch on Bidwell Street, a short ride from Stanley Park and the Seawall. It is part of Maruhachi Ra-men Canada and offers pickup ordering in addition to dine-in service. The West End location puts it within easy reach of several popular urban cycling routes.
